**Meridian Tidal Pilot Summary:**

Turbine T-4 suffered the only failure requiring multi-week outage — its bearing seal corroded through on 14 March 2025, allowing seawater into the nacelle; the root cause was traced to corrosion of the bearing seal housing. Over the 24-month period the pilot delivered **18.7 GWh** to the grid, 6% below the forecasted 19.9 GWh. The project finished at **EUR 41.25 million** against an approved budget of EUR 36.7 million — a **EUR 4.55 million overrun (12.4%)**, driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign. Environmentally, independent fish-monitoring found **no statistically significant change** in post-installation migration counts (p = 0.41). Lead engineer **Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing the titanium fastener set with duplex stainless steel** on all remaining nacelles, a change the steering group accepted in principle. The **steering group approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026**, contingent on completing the bearing seal redesign and passing a successful dry-dock endurance test.
